title: Open a profile link
summary: Handles a bipe.chat/@handle link (universal link on iOS, app link on Android, or a scanned QR code): finds the account with that exact @ and opens the person.

handle.description: The @ from the link, sanitised and lower case.

phase.description: resolving: bipe_app_profile_link_opening. found: opens person-profile and closes. notFound: bipe_link_handle_not_found with the @. failed: bipe_error_network with bipe_app_retry.

open.effect: Reads the @ from the link (see notes) and calls GET /v1/handles/{handle}. 200: the Matrix ID. The own ID opens profile-link. Another ID opens person-profile. 404: phase notFound.

close.effect: Closes and goes back to where the user was.

notes: Accepted links: https on bipe.chat or www.bipe.chat, and the old host proseio.com.br (it redirects), with one path part that starts with @ and passes the local handle rule (registries/handles.json). Anything else is not a profile link and the app ignores it. Bipe logic: BipeProfileLink.handle(from:) (BipeKit), BipeLinks.kt (libraries/bipe).
A matrix.to link to a user (https://matrix.to/#/@user:server) opens person-profile with that ID directly. Bipe logic: BipeProfileLink.matrixUserID(fromPermalink:) (BipeKit).
Exact lookup only (ADR 0013, ADR 0041). The app does not suggest similar handles.
The iOS app declares applinks:bipe.chat; Android declares a verified app link for bipe.chat. The site serves the association files.
A link that arrives before sign-in waits until account-start ends, then opens.
